this paper is the first to present the CRLB on the mean square error of the CP decomposition of a tensor from observations, (i..e, noisy data).
the proposed expressions can be useful for design of algorithms for the CP decomposition and for checking stability and accuracy of the CP decomposition of noisy observations.
the CRLB can serve as a benchmark for performance and stability of the CP decomposition of a tensor.
